top.title: Google releases AX, an open agent orchestrator

top.title: deja-vu shares one memory across coding agents
top.newly_possible: You can search and reuse fixes from past sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI and others, using history already on disk.

top.title: NVIDIA Model-Optimizer unifies model compression techniques
top.newly_possible: You can apply quantization, distillation, pruning, architecture search and speculative decoding from one library, targeting TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or vLLM.

top.title: Tool-calling model small enough for microcontrollers
top.newly_possible: You can run tool calls, structured extraction and embeddings from a 2-bit model of 8 to 29 MB on phones, wearables, robots and microcontrollers.

top.title: Secure tunnel connects private MCP servers to OpenAI
top.newly_possible: You can connect private or localhost MCP servers to ChatGPT, Codex, the Responses API and AgentKit without exposing them to the public internet.
